title: Velocity magnitude
description: Essential: The magnitude of the velocity upon entering the magnetic field is correctly given as (2√3/3)v₀.

title: Velocity direction
description: Essential: The direction of the velocity upon entering the magnetic field is correctly given as 30° above the positive x-axis.

title: Minimum B for y-axis exit
description: Essential: The minimum magnetic induction B for the proton to exit along the y-axis is correctly derived as √3 m v₀ / (e d).

title: B for exit at M
description: Important: The magnetic induction B_θ for the proton to exit at point M is correctly expressed in terms of n, e.g., (4√3 n m v₀)/(3 e d).

title: Period T of field variation
description: Important: The period T of the magnetic field variation is correctly expressed in terms of n, e.g., (√3 π d)/(6 n v₀).

title: Electric field kinematics
description: Important: The solution correctly applies kinematics in the electric field region to find the y-component of velocity at the origin.

title: Circular motion geometry
description: Important: The solution correctly uses geometry of circular motion (e.g., chord/radius relationships) to relate the path radius to the given distances d.

title: Lorentz force application
description: Important: The solution correctly applies the Lorentz force law (evB = mv²/R) to relate B, v, and the orbital radius.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign for the velocity components or angle, or misidentifying the direction of the magnetic force.

title: Unit or factor mistake
description: Pitfall: Missing factors (like √3, π, or numerical coefficients) in final expressions for B or T.
